product.title: Waterfalls of Yosemite - Customizable Private Tour

description.text: Explore Yosemite’s legendary waterfalls with a local expert on a fully customizable private tour. Routes may include Bridalveil Fall, Yosemite Falls, Vernal Fall, Nevada Fall, and other cascades depending on season, trail access, and your group’s preferences.

highlights: Reservation into Yosemite included on day of activity
Routes tailored for hiking or car-based touring

start.description: Meet your guide at Curry Village Pizza Deck near Shuttle Stop 14 in Yosemite Valley.

end.description: Finish near the Curry Village meeting area after your private waterfall tour.

product.itinerarySummary: Explore Yosemite’s legendary waterfalls with a local expert on a fully customizable private tour.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Valley
itineraryItems.description: Private routing through Yosemite Valley waterfall viewpoints tailored to season and fitness.

itineraryItems.title: Bridalveil Fall
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Bridalveil Fall when included in your custom route.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Falls
itineraryItems.description: Visit Lower Yosemite Fall and surrounding viewpoints.

itineraryItems.title: Vernal Fall
itineraryItems.description: Approach Vernal Fall on the Mist Trail when trail conditions permit.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Waterfalls of Yosemite - Customizable Private Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 6 to 8 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Yosemite?
faqs.answer: Meet your guide at Curry Village Pizza Deck near Shuttle Stop 14 in Yosemite Valley.
